general_information.Description: Advanced C ++ Programming is the next advanced course of basic C ++ Programming. The course provides necessary complicated skills such as Understanding object-oriented properties in C ++ (inheritance, polymorphism, destructors, constructors, virtual functions, namespaces), generic programming concepts, generic algorithms , template in C +; exception handling in C ++; data structures in C ++ (stack, queue, list, tree); basic sorting algorithms with C ++ (selection sort, insertion sort, merge sort, quick sort); basic search algorithms with C ++ (linear search, binary search); container concept in C ++ (sequential container, associative container); concepts of stream input/output and string stream, being able to manipulate input and output data with file; generic concepts and being able to implement generic function, generic class, and manipulate algorithms with generic
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students should self-study all lessons on LMS in time - Pass all conditions before taking final exam in campus

description: Advanced C ++ Programming is the next advanced course of basic C ++ Programming. learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand and present the inheritance in C++
Understand the “member variables / functions” having the “protected” access modifier
Understand and present what the polymorphism, abstract class and virtual function are
Be able to design and create the base and derived classes in C++
Understand the generic programming concept and its necessity in C++
Be able to create a generic function in C++
Be able to create a template class in C++
Understand what an exception is and why the exception handling is needed
Be able to create classes / functions which can throw an exception
Be able to write code applying the handling exception
Be understandable about stream
Be able to create code working with input/output streams
Be able to create code with file input/output
Understand the container concepts in C++ like: sequence container, associative container
Understand the structure of a Vector
Understand and implement a List structure in C++
Understand and implement a Deque structure in C++
Understand and explain the Pair class
Understand and implement a Map structure in C++
Understand and explain a Set structure in C++
Understand the multimap and the multiset concepts
Understand and explain the generic algorithms
Understand and implement the read only and read write algorithms
Understand and implement the sorting algorithm with generic programming
Understand and explain the iterator
Understand, present and implement the Stack data structure
Understand, present and implement the Queue data structure
Understand and implement the Binary Tree data structure in C++
Understand and implement the Linked List data structure in C++
Understand and explain the Linear Search algorithm
Be able to implement the Linear Search algorithm into C++ programming language
Understand and present the Binary Search algorithm
Be able to implement the Binary Search algorithm into C++ programming language
Understand and implement the Selection Sort algorithm into C++ programming language
Understand and implement the Insertion Sort algorithm into C++ programming language
Understand and implement the Merge Sort algorithm into C++ programming language
Understand and implement the Quick Sort into C++ programming language
Understand the namespace concept and be able to apply it in C++ programming
Understand and work with std::string in C++
